app.name: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition
app.coder: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition contributors
app.long_description: v0.4 experimental movement and environment lab. Adds source-derived low dive, backflip/recovery roll, swimming, Hover/Rocket/Turbo adapters, materials, slopes and tile water. New action poses and environment graphics are temporary; Story Mode fidelity is incomplete. A jumps, B/Classic X spins, Z/Classic ZR pounds. Stick or D-pad Down dives. Hold Remote 1/Classic Y/GC R for FLUDD; Remote 2/Classic ZL/GC L cycles nozzles. PLUS/HOME/START pauses. No yellow spin squares or Level Designer.
